properties.statement: Building record_the_build (2026-10-25): wrote a throwaway script that loads tools/tool_confusability.py's replica, swaps one tool's name and description, and reports its rank for its own corpus query, the new not-first tools and the new mutual pairs against find_tools_rank_baseline.json; swept about 20 name/description variants with it before choosing one. The replica has no 'try this description' mode, so naming a new tool against the confusability gate meant a rebuild per attempt or a hand-rolled harness.
